description: This Java source file defines an abstract class `ExecutionContextAuthHandler` that implements authentication handling for device requests using Vert.x framework. It provides methods to authenticate devices based on execution context and manages external authentication providers.

classes.name: ExecutionContextAuthHandler
classes.description: An abstract class for handling device authentication within a given execution context, utilizing an external Vert.x authentication provider.

methods.name: ExecutionContextAuthHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the auth handler with a specific AuthProvider.

methods.name: getAuthProvider
methods.description: Returns the AuthProvider used for authentication, defaulting to the configured provider or overridden by context.

methods.name: authenticateDevice
methods.description: Performs device authentication based on the provided execution context, returning a Future that completes with a DeviceUser or an error.
